story.vex: Restore first. Lose your evidence. It's a simple trick and it works every time. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED, evidence intact: the tampered log was fingerprinted before it was restored. Astro: "Same two steps. Right order. That's the whole difference."
